g.text: Expiry job: at startup and on the configured cron (US-202, US-203, US-204)
[cron fires (default "0 5 0 * * *" in the configured zone: US-202.4)]
[while the last batch was full (batch-size, default 1000)]
WITH due AS (SELECT … WHERE maturity_date < ? AND expired = false
LIMIT ? FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE … RETURNING *
"<" not "<=": a trade maturing today stays live (A-17).
Already-expired rows are never returned, so a re-run
writes nothing (idempotent, US-202.2). The job never
sets expired back to false (US-204.2). Rows locked by
ingestion or another instance are skipped.
log INFO outcome=EXPIRED tradeId=… per trade
log ERROR with cause; the next run (or restart) catches up
Several instances may run the job at once: FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
makes each trade expire (and be audited) exactly once (A-42).
